difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the composition morphism for RSheafHom on a ringed site, from the derived tensor product of RSheafHom(L, M) and RSheafHom(K, L) to RSheafHom(K, M) (statement lines 8997-9008). The construction needs three competing representative choices at once: M and L must be represented by K-injective complexes so that the internal hom complexes compute RSheafHom, while the middle factor has to be replaced by a K-flat representative so that the tensor product computes the derived tensor product, and only then can the two displayed arrows be composed (proof lines 9012-9047). The non-formal point is exactly this bookkeeping, which the author spells out. The claim is H2: one construction whose input is a choice of resolutions, with the omitted functoriality not being part of the counted assertion.
